title: dracaena zeylanica
intro: Dracaena zeylanica, commonly known as Ceylon sago, is a plant species in the Dracaena genus, native to Sri Lanka and Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis, asthma, and allergies. The therapeutic actions of Dracaena zeylanica include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic, making it useful in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Dracaena zeylanica include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
